caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned slightly to the right within a rectangular frame on an off-white or light beige background. The chair has a curved, rounded back with several vertical spindles connecting the seat to the top rail. The seat is contoured with visible wood grain and a worn texture, colored in varying shades of brown and gray, giving the appearance of aged wood. The chair stands on four legs that are tapered and turned, with horizontal stretchers connecting each leg for added stability. There are subtle, soft shadows under the chair and legs, cast slightly to the right, indicating a light source from the upper left. The drawing is bordered by a thin, double-lined frame close to the edges of the paper. No other objects are present in the composition.
title: Chair
